A wolf pack that crossed through a Rift surge together and emerged as something more — and less — than wolves. Rifthollowed wolves share a psychic pack-link stronger than any natural bond, allowing them to coordinate hunts across miles. Their howls cause Veil-tremors that disorient prey and attract lesser Rift phenomena.
## Traits
**Keen Hearing and Smell.** Advantage on Perception relying on hearing/smell.

## Actions
**Multiattack.** In humanoid form: two greatclub or longbow attacks. In hybrid/wolf: bite + claws.
**Bite.** +4 to hit, 6 (1d8 + 2) piercing. DC 12 CON save or cursed with Rift-touch.
